headline: Lai Ching-te Promises NT$10,000 Universal Handout Next Year! One Local Candidate Raises the Bid: If I'm Elected, Citizens Get NT$20,000
summary: President Lai Ching-te announced a NT$10,000 cash handout to everyone in 2027, which he attributed to strong economic growth driven by the AI industry. The plan has sparked debate.
why: Taiwan's economy is closely tied to global semiconductor and AI supply chains, so growth in that sector shapes fiscal policy and public spending decisions.
